//: How the people of this mod answer what the social layer tells them (15 §10 to §12), until minds and goals (09) do it for them. Each is a plain rule a mod may switch off with its rule group: set the setting `core:social_life` to false.
doc: The bundled answers to orders, calls for help and reports. On unless the setting `core:social_life` is false.

//: Do as ordered: an order kept is put in the plan. The AI's goal of the same name replaces this (09 §8.1).
doc: Puts the action an order says to do at the end of the plan of whoever kept it.
A servant that is no longer one drops what it was told to do.

//: The watch hears a call for help: a guard remembers it, where it came from and who called, for a goal to answer.
doc: A member of the watch who hears a call for help remembers it, as `core:help_called`, where it came from.

//: A guard told what someone saw passes it to the watch, so that every guard knows it (15 §9.2).
doc: A member of the watch who is told something adds it to the watch's knowledge.
